messages:
Joelle Perez: Hi team! Joelle here, starting on Customer Success today. Im based in SF and bring a very friendly golden retriever named Mochi to the office sometimes. Excited to meet yall!
Sam Rivera: Welcome Joelle!! :tada: Mochi photos required when you bring them in. We do an unofficial 'pet parade' at 4pm sometimes.
Joelle Perez: Absolutely will deliver Mochi pics \uD83D\uDC36 Also curious: is there a preferred lunch spot near the office for a casual team picnic?
Aiden Cho: Welcome!! Theres a tiny park across the street with picnic tables. We also sometimes grab sliders from the food truck by the loading dock.
Maya Patel: Hi Joelle  welcome!! Quick poll: team picnic Friday noon? React with :sunny: if yes or :umbrella: if youd prefer another day.
Sam Rivera: :sunny: count me in.
Joelle Perez: :sunny: love a picnic + Mochi will bring his squeaky ball.
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Joelle Perez  Customer Success  SF"
Maya Patel: Also small note: if Mochi is coming, bring a spare towel for the rooftop grass just in case.
Joelle Perez: Will do! Thanks everyone  looking forward to Friday.
